title: moraea pyrophila
intro: Moraea pyrophila, commonly known as Fire Lily, is a flowering plant species in the Iridaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Moraea pyrophila include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Moraea pyrophila include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
